# ma.cyou

> Personal sites of Timofey (Mapagmataas), a developer in Novosibirsk who builds web systems for working with data: APIs, PostgreSQL and Redis, interfaces, and the Linux servers they run on.

The sites are available in English and Russian (add `?lang=ru` for Russian).

## Sites

- [Résumé](https://me.ma.cyou/): experience, skills, education and contacts
- [Projects](https://projects.ma.cyou/): things that are actually online, each with its own page under /p/
- [PocketCam](https://pocketcam.ma.cyou/): phone browser as a Windows 11 webcam
- [Chat](https://chat.ma.cyou/): invite-only, end-to-end encrypted messenger for direct and small group chats (sign-in page; conversations need an invite)
